resources.string: Saarthi reads button labels and UI positions on your screen to guide you with voice instructions and glowing highlight boxes. All screen analysis is performed 100% locally on your device via Gemini Nano. No personal information, balances, or passwords are ever saved or transmitted to the cloud.
